plans.title: Choose your plan
plans.intro: Pick the plan and billing cycle that fit your business.
plans.empty: No plans are available right now. Please check back soon.
plans.error: We couldn't load the plans. Please try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.acceptedTermsLabel: I accept the Terms of Service

success.title: Check your email
success.body: We sent a verification link to {email}. Verify your email to continue setting up your workspace.

errors.weakPassword: Your password must be 10–128 characters long.
errors.validation: We couldn't create your account. Please check the form and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

planUnavailable.message: The plan you selected is no longer available.

duplicateEmail.message: This email cannot be used to create a new account. If it's yours, sign in or reset your password instead.
duplicateEmail.recoveryUnavailable: Account recovery is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

success.title: Email verified
success.body: Your email address has been verified. Continue to finish setting up your workspace.

invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.body: This verification link is missing, expired, invalid, or has already been used. Request a new one below.

resend.confirmation: If that email has a pending verification, a new link is on its way.
resend.error: We couldn't send the email. Please try again.

mfa.title: Protect your account
mfa.description: Use an authenticator app for an extra layer of security.
mfa.optional: This is optional. You can skip it now and enable it later.

setup.title: Set up your authenticator
setup.body: Continue to Keycloak's secure setup, scan its QR code with your authenticator app, then return here to confirm.

complete.title: Multi-factor authentication is active
complete.body: Your account now requires your authenticator when you sign in.

mfa.error: We couldn't complete MFA setup. You can retry or skip for now.

provisioning.title: Workspace setup
provisioning.waiting: Your workspace is being prepared. This page checks progress automatically.

ready.title: Your workspace is ready
ready.body: Your workspace has been created. Company setup will be available when that step is released.

failed.title: Workspace setup failed
failed.body: We could not finish setting up your workspace. You can retry safely or contact support.

connection.title: Checking your workspace
connection.body: We could not check progress right now. We will keep trying.
connection.offline: You are offline. We will check again when your connection returns.

provisioning.conflict: Another setup attempt is already running. Checking its progress.
provisioning.retryError: Could not request a retry. Please try again or contact support.
provisioning.supportUnavailable: Support contact is not configured. Please ask your organization administrator for assistance.

unauthorized.title: Session expired
unauthorized.body: Sign in again to check your workspace.

unverified.title: Verify your email
unverified.body: Verify your email before accessing your workspace.

missing.title: Workspace unavailable
missing.body: We could not find a workspace for this account. Sign in again or contact your administrator.
